plan.title: Round 3: make the sacrifice obvious
items: Your ask (9 Nov): the hundred must be seen to decide it's worth dying for, so the viewer leaves feeling it's now their job.
All three new drafts start the same way, with your seven timeline notes: Derek asks 'What will it feel like?', the lady asks 'And afterwards?', and Maddie answers in two things.

Then each draft gives a different moment of choosing. 1H: Maddie asks 'Are you sure?', and the lady says it's worth it and asks us not to waste it. 1I: sitting down is the vote. 1J: the door's open and nobody leaves.
My pick is 1H. 'Just make sure they don't waste it' puts the debt on the viewer without stating a moral.

plan.title: You decide
items: Pick 1H, 1I or 1J, or note any line. 1H with 1I's 'take a seat' as its last beat also works: say 'H plus seat'.

replies.1-1C: Done as 1D: 1C plus your ending in Maddie's last line, "Back to before it all went wrong. And you'll be there. Still you. And this time, we've got a chance to fix it." 'Not this you' before it keeps the cost real. About 25 s.
replies.2: Done as 2D, your words: Sandra "You know what? I'm looking forward to hanging out with you. Before the world ended." / Derek "Yes, me too, love. Are you ready for this?" then hands and fade to white.
replies.q4: Planted in scene A and the walk out; 2D no longer needs it.
replies.top: Round 3: three new drafts (1H, 1I, 1J) for your 'up the ante' note. They're at the end of the wafer tab.
